rejected.description: €26 for a fall semester in Vienna. 🍂 Growing up here, I don’t think you really question it. You walk into these old university buildings, spend afternoons in rooms that feel like they belong to another century, cross the courtyard while the leaves slowly turn brown and somehow all of it just becomes normal. It’s only when you start looking at studying abroad and see what a semester can cost elsewhere that you realise how unusual it actually is to have university education supported like this. I will never take this for granted. And autumn might be my favourite time to notice it. The first weeks still feel warm, then the courtyard gets quieter, coats start replacing sweaters, the light disappears earlier behind the old stone walls and before you know it, everyone is waiting for the first snow.❄️ . . . . #vienna #wien #fallsemester #university #darkacademia

rejected.description: If you’re searching for beautiful towns to visit in 🇦🇹Austria, especially somewhere that feels completely different from the usual Hallstatt style itinerary, remember this one. Because there’s one thing nobody warns you about when you start exploring Austria… some places will completely ruin your standards. You know those places where one beautiful thing would already be enough? Now add grand historic buildings, steep little streets, mountains surrounding the town and one feature that makes the whole place almost impossible to compare to anywhere else. And I haven’t even told you where we are yet. This is Bad Gastein, in Salzburg state, and it became one of those places I knew I wanted to see again before I had even left. It’s famous for its thermal springs and Belle Époque architecture, but what gives its personality for me is how dramatic the whole setting feels. It’s definitely not your typical cute Austrian Alpine village. And on this particular November day? Well… you saw the Reel. 🥹❄️ 🫶Tell me you wouldn’t fall in love with this town too. #austriatravel #austriatips #salzburgerland #badgastein #austriatravel
